data.name: Football Legacy Manager 26
data.detailed_description:
Become the ultimate American football general manager in Football Legacy Manager 26 (FLM26)! Take control of a professional American football team and create an enduring legacy. Experience the most immersive PC football manager with features that let you dominate the league for decades!

🏈THE ULTIMATE AMERICAN FOOTBALL GM EXPERIENCE🏈
Manage every aspect of your team, from coaching and scouting to drafting and trading. Negotiate contracts and develop players to lead your team to victory.

🧠OFFLINE AMERICAN FOOTBALL MANAGER🧠
Play anytime, anywhere - no internet connection required! FLM26 lets you enjoy the excitement of managing your American football team whenever you want.

⬆️UNIQUE CAREER STORYLINES⬆️
Follow the evolution of the entire league, witnessing teams rise from declining contenders to rising superstars. Track league records, draft classes, player transactions, and more!

🌐FULLY CUSTOMIZABLE🌐
Customize players, teams, coaches, and leagues! Take control of your American football universe and shape its future with expansion drafts.

🆕 What’s New in FLM26

This year’s edition adds some of the most requested features from the community:

League Control: Take charge of any league, not just the top one. Adjust rules, manage expansion, set contract and trade policies, or even switch control mid-career.

Promotion & Relegation: Create a multi-division system where teams can move up or down depending on results.

Player Specialties: Star players now have unique traits that make them stand out and change the way you build your roster.

Career Mode: Start as a rookie GM and build your reputation over time. Change teams, chase challenges, and leave your mark on football history.

Tryouts: Invite players to camp on a tryout and see if they earn a contract before the season begins.

🎮PROLONGED GAMING EXPERIENCE🎮
With Football Legacy Manager, you can play for decades and even centuries, experiencing the thrill of Football management for ages!

🏈Start your General Manager career now and leave your mark on the American football world! Try Football Legacy Manager 26 today!
